title: Authentication delays
mitigation: Implement multi-factor authentication and regular security audits.

title: Database schema changes after week 2
description: Could invalidate API and UI work.
mitigation: Schedule database changes during a maintenance window.

title: Frontend/backend integration delays
description: If API contracts are not agreed early.
mitigation: Agree API contracts early and conduct thorough testing.

title: QA bottleneck
description: A single QA engineer must test everything in the last two weeks.
mitigation: Increase QA team size or extend testing phases.

title: Deployment issues
description: Discovered late because production-like environments are not used early.
mitigation: Use production-like environments early and conduct thorough testing.

title: Scope creep
description: Stakeholders asking for extra features during the month.
mitigation: Set clear scope and communicate it to stakeholders.
